versions.changelog:
- Major upgrade introducing version 2.0.1 with expanded practical compliance and policy execution expertise for Chinese Government Procurement Law.
- Now integrates six core functions: intelligent Q&A, procurement document review, case search, compliance checkup, policy implementation assessment, and protest/complaint assistance.
- Strict knowledge-base-first workflow, with precise legal citation and boundaries between Government Procurement Law and Tendering/Bidding Law.
- Modular workflows and detailed output templates for each function, including structured risk alerts, case summaries, and actionable checklists.
- Enhanced user guidance: clarifies module routing, input requirements, and scope; actively filters and redirects out-of-scope inquiries.
- Clear, professional, and risk-oriented communication style, with compulsory reference standards, timelines, and legal disclaimers.
